0.name: Zero
0.core: Zero is the circle with no start and no end. It amplifies every digit beside it and points to raw potential waiting for a choice.
0.spirit: A reminder that you are connected to something larger than the moment you are in. Stillness, prayer or meditation opens the next door.
0.spirit1: A reminder that you are connected to something larger than the moment you are in.
0.love: Relationships are resetting. Old patterns can end so a healthier cycle can start.
0.love_tail: Old patterns can end so a healthier cycle can start.
0.tf: Signals a spiritual reset between two people: the connection is being cleared of past baggage.
0.career: A blank page. Great time to plan, study and choose one direction before you commit money.
0.warn: Drifting. Endless options without a decision become zero results.
0.warn_lc: drifting. Endless options without a decision become zero results.
0.act: Pick one intention and write it down today.
0.bible: Often linked with the eternal nature of God — without beginning or end.

1.name: One
1.core: One is the pioneer. It starts things, stands alone when needed and turns thoughts into first steps.
1.spirit: Your thoughts are seeds. What you focus on now tends to grow, so keep your attention on what you want, not what you fear.
1.love: Take initiative. Singles: make the first move. Couples: lead with honesty and own your needs.
1.love_tail: Couples: lead with honesty and own your needs.
1.tf: Individual growth comes first; union follows when both people stand on their own feet.
1.career: Launch, pitch, apply. Ideal for starting a business, a side project or asking for the lead role.
1.warn: Ego and isolation. Leadership without listening burns bridges.
1.warn_lc: ego and isolation. Leadership without listening burns bridges.
1.act: Start the task you have been postponing — even a 10-minute version.
1.bible: Unity and the primacy of God ("the first and the last").

2.name: Two
2.core: Two is the diplomat. It seeks harmony, cooperation and the quiet strength of patience.
2.spirit: Trust the timing. Things are aligning behind the scenes even if you cannot see progress yet.
2.love: Partnership energy is high. Listen more, compromise wisely and nurture trust.
2.love_tail: Listen more, compromise wisely and nurture trust.
2.tf: Mirror-soul energy: balance your giving and receiving before reunion.
2.career: Collaborate. Partnerships, joint ventures and team roles outperform solo pushes right now.
2.warn: People-pleasing and indecision. Balance does not mean erasing yourself.
2.warn_lc: people-pleasing and indecision. Balance does not mean erasing yourself.
2.act: Reach out to one person you want to build with.
2.bible: Union and witness — two are better than one.

3.name: Three
3.core: Three is the creator and communicator. It expands, expresses and brings optimism into the room.
3.spirit: Your guides are close and supportive. Express yourself — your voice is part of your path.
3.spirit1: Your guides are close and supportive.
3.love: Playful energy. Flirt, laugh, communicate openly; a social event may spark something new.
3.love_tail: Flirt, laugh, communicate openly; a social event may spark something new.
3.tf: Communication is the bridge. Say what you have been holding back.
3.career: Create, write, publish, sell. Content, marketing and any creative work are favoured.
3.warn: Scattered focus. Too many ideas, not enough finished work.
3.warn_lc: scattered focus. Too many ideas, not enough finished work.
3.act: Share one piece of your work publicly.

4.name: Four
4.core: Four is the builder. Structure, discipline and systems that last.
4.spirit: You are protected and supported while you build. Slow and steady is not a weakness here.
4.spirit1: You are protected and supported while you build.
4.love: Commitment, reliability and practical love. Build routines together.
4.tf: Grounding before reunion — steady your life so the connection has a home.
4.career: Systems, processes and long-term assets. Fix the foundation before scaling.
4.warn: Rigidity and burnout. Work without rest cracks the foundation.
4.warn_lc: rigidity and burnout. Work without rest cracks the foundation.
4.act: Organise one area of your life: finances, calendar or workspace.
4.bible: Creation and the earth — the four corners, the four seasons.

5.name: Five
5.core: Five is the explorer. Movement, variety, travel and fast learning.
5.spirit: Change is arriving for your benefit. Loosen your grip and adapt.
5.spirit1: Change is arriving for your benefit.
5.love: New experiences refresh love. Singles may meet someone while travelling or trying something new.
5.love_tail: Singles may meet someone while travelling or trying something new.
5.tf: Change and movement — separation may be shifting into a new phase.
5.career: Pivot, test, experiment. Sales, travel, media and digital work are favoured.
5.warn: Restlessness and impulsive risk. Freedom without direction is just noise.
5.warn_lc: restlessness and impulsive risk. Freedom without direction is just noise.
5.act: Change one habit or route this week on purpose.

6.name: Six
6.core: Six is the nurturer. Family, home, service and beauty.
6.spirit: Balance the material and the spiritual. Your needs are met when you stop worrying about them.
6.spirit1: Balance the material and the spiritual.
6.love: Deep devotion and domestic harmony. A strong number for commitment and family.
6.love_tail: A strong number for commitment and family.
6.tf: Healing and unconditional love are the path to union.
6.career: Service, wellness, education, design and real estate are favoured. Take care of clients.
6.career1: Service, wellness, education, design and real estate are favoured.
6.warn: Over-giving and control. Caring is not carrying everyone.
6.warn_lc: over-giving and control. Caring is not carrying everyone.
6.act: Do one thing that makes your home or body feel cared for.
6.bible: Humanity — created on the sixth day.

7.name: Seven
7.core: Seven is the seeker. Research, reflection, faith and inner knowing.
7.spirit: You are on the right path. Study, solitude and intuition lead to your next insight.
7.spirit1: You are on the right path.
7.love: Depth over drama. You want a partner who understands your inner world.
7.love_tail: You want a partner who understands your inner world.
7.tf: Spiritual awakening; the connection teaches rather than just comforts.
7.career: Research, analysis, tech, writing and specialist expertise pay off.
7.career1: Research, analysis, tech, writing and specialist expertise pay off.
7.warn: Overthinking and withdrawal. Insight you never share helps no one.
7.warn_lc: overthinking and withdrawal. Insight you never share helps no one.
7.act: Spend 20 minutes in silence or journaling before a decision.
7.bible: Completion and spiritual perfection — the seventh day of rest.

8.name: Eight
8.core: Eight is the executive. Money, authority, results and the law of cause and effect.
8.spirit: What you give returns. Abundance flows when effort, integrity and generosity line up.
8.love: Power balance matters. Build a partnership of equals with shared goals.
8.love_tail: Build a partnership of equals with shared goals.
8.tf: Karmic cycles closing; lessons repeat until they are learned.
8.career: Scale, invest, negotiate. Strong for business, finance and leadership.
8.warn: Greed and control. Money without integrity reverses fast.
8.warn_lc: greed and control. Money without integrity reverses fast.
8.act: Review your numbers: income, spend, one investment decision.

9.name: Nine
9.core: Nine is the humanitarian. Endings, wisdom and service to a larger cause.
9.spirit: A chapter is closing so a bigger purpose can open. Release what has run its course.
9.spirit1: A chapter is closing so a bigger purpose can open.
9.love: Forgive, release and love with maturity. An ending may make space for the right person.
9.love_tail: An ending may make space for the right person.
9.tf: Completion of a cycle — reunion or release, both bring peace.
9.career: Finish projects, give back, mentor. Purpose-led work is favoured.
9.warn: Holding on to what has ended. Martyrdom is not service.
9.warn1: Holding on to what has ended.
9.warn_lc: holding on to what has ended. Martyrdom is not service.
9.act: Close one open loop: send, finish, forgive or let go.
9.bible: Finality and the fruit of the Spirit.

11.name: Master 11
11.core: Master number 11 carries heightened intuition and the potential to inspire others.

22.name: Master 22
22.core: Master number 22 turns big visions into structures that serve many people.

33.name: Master 33
33.core: Master number 33 is the teacher of love — service, healing and uplifting others.
